changes.text: Reads and writes TigerTag spool tags — the open standard eSun, Sunlu and Rosa3D ship — with material, brand, temperatures, weight and drying info resolved from the official registry.
Factory-signed TigerTag+ chips are verified offline, and the scan hub says whether a tag is genuine.
The write form's material and brand show exactly which registry entry will be written, with a searchable picker.
Introduces drag-and-drop in location management. Drag spools between locations, and drag locations into your own order; SpoolKid remembers locations order.
Select several spools and assign them all to one location at once, or sort locations by name, spool count, or your own arrangement.
Clone Tag copies a scanned tag onto another tag byte for byte, offered right in the Scan Result Hub.
Anycubic ACE writes now put the spool's ID in the SKU by default, and the write form takes diameter and net weight.
Your Bluetooth scale is set up once, and SpoolKid learns its zero point by watching it rest empty.
A scanned spool's filament opens for editing with a tap, a missing manufacturer or filament can be created on the spot, and captions say where each detail came from.
Deleting a vendor, filament, or location that spools still use explains what would go with it and lets you decide, instead of failing quietly.
A refused delete, archive, or write now says so instead of closing as if it worked, and FilaMan's own error messages are read properly.
ELEGOO and OpenTag3D tags are read straight off the tag instead of by guesswork, and password-protected ACE tags are refused with an explanation.
Weigh a spool on a kitchen scale and SpoolKid works out what filament is left.
Previous measurements are listed on the spool, including ones recorded by FilaMan.
Search now matches your words across every field instead of the whole phrase against one.
Every scan routes to the Scan Result Hub, whichever backend and settings you use.
The spool form explains why a weight mode is unavailable instead of showing nothing.
